# Alpha 42 — mobile documents, folders and SMB connections

- Add multiple SMB/Mac server connections with device-protected credentials or session-only access.
- Group open and stored documents by type, add optional document preview cards, and offer TXT or Markdown when creating a document.
- Add an optional restart preference that closes clean documents while retaining stored files and unsaved drafts.
- Simplify folder navigation and actions, including local/remote mapping navigation and removal that keeps files.
- Organize settings by feature and improve native navigation, appearance and transfer presentation.

Local validation passed 149 mobile UI/tooling tests, 46 mobile core tests (three native-bridge tests skipped), and the Go bridge tests. The physical iPhone build passed signing and identity verification; installation is a separate device operation. The release workflow must pass its desktop and Android/iOS build/runtime gates before publication.
